learning_outcomes.text: Obtain knowledge from logic control, control engineering and technical devices.

syllabus_topics: Theory and practice of combinatorial and sequential circuits
Laplace transform, solution of differential equations
Description of static and dynamic properties of systems
Synthesis of controllers (the method based on experiment and the analytic solution)
Controllers - electronic, hydraulic, pneumatic and mechanical
Actuators - electric motors, hydraulic and pneumatic
Sensors for temperature, position, pressure, force and flow
